attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI Regulation 30. Senior management will conduct one-on-one and group meetings on 17, 19, and 20 November 2026, starting from 09:00 AM. The interactions will be held physically in Mumbai. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings. The details are also available on the company website. Ravi Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, filed this disclosure with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from continuing operations of INR430 crores for Q2 FY27, compared to INR176 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. Profit after tax from continuing operations increased to INR209 crores in Q2 FY27, up from INR69 crores. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue stood at INR726 crores, with profit after tax at INR269 crores. The company highlighted its demerger from HEG Limited and progress in advanced materials, including a graphite anode plant in Dewas and graphene production. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "TACC Limited signs a non-binding MoU with global lithium-ion cell manufacturer for supply of Anode Active Material".
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with a global lithium-ion cell manufacturer. The agreement outlines a proposed long-term supply of up to 40,000 tonnes of synthetic graphite-based Anode Active Material for electric mobility applications. The arrangement is subject to further discussions and finalization of technical and commercial requirements. The collaboration also includes research and custom development of next-generation fast-charging and high-range battery materials. TACC Limited is currently developing production capabilities for anode active material and graphene. This announcement was made pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "TACC Receives Approval Letter for Rs 609.50 Crore Incentive under ECMS for its Synthetic Graphite Anode Material Project in Dewas".
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, received an approval letter for an incentive of Rs 609.50 crore under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme. The incentive supports TACC’s Synthetic Graphite Anode Material project in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The facility spans over 100 acres and targets a phase one capacity of 20,000 tonnes per annum by June 2027. The project aims for a total committed capacity beyond 30,000 metric tonnes per annum by FY2028-29. The approval is subject to scheme guidelines and prescribed conditions.
